tabProjectsDesc: Manage your registered projects. Each project card shows status at a glance.
addProjectDesc: Tap here to connect a GitHub/GitLab repository. Import via OAuth or enter the URL and token manually.
addProjectEmptyDesc: No projects yet! Tap this button to connect a GitHub/GitLab repository.
projectStatsDesc: Shows Waiting, Working, Verifying, Done, and Merge counts. Tap each number to open a detail panel.
projectScannerDesc: Pause or resume automatic task detection.
projectScanDesc: Check for new tasks immediately without waiting for the next scan cycle.
tabAgentsDesc: Manage both AI agents (auto-coding) and verifiers (human review) in one place.
agentsFilterDesc: Filter by All, Agents, or Verifiers. The number next to Verifiers shows pending reviews.
addAgentDesc: Register a new AI agent. Choose a CLI tool (Claude Code, OpenCode) and give it a name.
addAgentEmptyDesc: No agents yet! Tap this button to register an AI agent.
agentCardDesc: Tap to expand or collapse details. Check version, max turns, and other settings.
agentStatsDesc: Shows Running, Done, and Failed counts. Tap each to open a detail panel.
agentInterviewDesc: Chat with the agent directly. Ask about its work approach or configuration.
agentTestDesc: Test whether the CLI is properly installed and responding.
tabIssuesDesc: Register tasks and monitor AI processing in real-time.
issuesProjectSelectDesc: First, choose the project to view tasks for. Auto-selected if only one project exists.
addIssueDesc: Create a new task directly. First line becomes the title, the rest is the body.
issuesFilterDesc: Filter tasks by stage: Waiting, In Progress, Verifying, Failed, Done, and more.
tabReportsDesc: View processing stats, costs, and agent performance by period.
reportsPeriodDesc: Choose Weekly/Monthly/Yearly and use arrows to navigate. Scroll down for detailed metrics.
tabAdminDesc: Manage user permissions, CLI paths, mail, OAuth, and other system settings.
adminSubTabsDesc: Navigate to Users, Mail, Settings, OAuth, or CLI sections.
